Wannan shine bidiyon don ƙirar 2 na Gudanar da Kasuwancin Kasuwanci.

panel.rule: Tattara ma'auni, sannan kawai a saki rigar.

say: Kwanan alkawari daga iyawar ku, ba daga bege ba. Misali, Funmi tana dinka kusan awa 30 a sati a shagonta na Ibadan. Abokin ciniki yana son riga mai layi a ranar Asabar na mako mai zuwa.

panel.heading: Shin Funmi za ta iya karɓar wannan odar?
items: Takan dinka kusan awa 30 a sati
Mako mai zuwa: 26 na awanni 30 an riga an yi rajista
Sabuwar riga mai layi: kamar awa 8 tare da dacewa
Bayar: makonni biyu, ko bayyana tare da biya taimako

say: Littafin odar ta yana nuna kusan awanni 4 kyauta kawai mako mai zuwa. Sabuwar rigar tana buƙatar kusan 8, don haka ba ta dace ba tare da kari ba.

say: Don haka ta ba da zaɓi na gaskiya: bayarwa a cikin makonni biyu akan farashi na yau da kullun, ko kuma cajin da ya dace wanda ke biyan ƙwararren mataimaki. Abokin ciniki ya zaɓi makonni biyu.

say: Yanzu farashi. Da farko nemo ƙimar kuɗin kan ku. Kudin tafiyar da Zainab ya kai kusan Naira 100,000 a wata, kuma tana dinka kusan awa 200, don haka kudin da ake samu ya kai Naira 500 a kowace awa.
Kayayyakinta sun kai kimanin naira 15,000, an saka musu 3,000, an gyara 2,000. Naira 20,000 kenan.
Rigar tana ɗaukar awanni 8. Ma’aikata a naira 1,000 a sa’a 8,000 ne, sannan kudin da ake kashewa a kan 500 a awa daya ya kai 4,000.
Jimlar kudin Naira 32,000. Wannan shine farashin falonta. Duk abin da ke ƙasa yana asarar kuɗi.
Kashi 25% ta raba kashi 0.75, kuma ta koma naira 43,000.
Cikakkun kunshin zainab ta kawo komai, dan haka dole ne farashin ya cika dukkan kayan.

panel.heading: Cikakken kunshin ko kudin dinki
right: Abokin ciniki yana kawo masana'anta da sutura

say: Da kudin dinki ta ke kawo kayan gyara kawai. Kudinta kusan 14,000 ne, don haka tana karbar kusan 19,000.
Idan shagon da ke kusa ya biya 12,000, ba za ta iya daidaita shi ba tare da asarar kuɗi ba. Ta yi gasa da dacewa da gamawa maimakon.
Idan abokin ciniki yana son ƙaramin farashi, canza tsari, ba gefen ku ba: salo mafi sauƙi, ko babu rufi.

panel.heading: Cikakken kunshin ko kudin dinki
right: Abokin ciniki yana kawo masana'anta da sutura

say: Bude wani asusu na daban don kasuwancin. Bayanin bankin ku daga nan ya zama rikodin na biyu na kuɗin kasuwanci.

panel.heading: Halaye uku waɗanda ke kare kuɗin ku

cards.d: Abokan ciniki suna biyan adibas da ma'auni a cikin asusun kasuwanci da ake amfani da su don shagon kawai.
Idan abokin ciniki ya ɓace, ba ku yi asarar kuɗi ba. Aiwatar da dokar ga kowa da kowa.
Biyan wa kanka adadin adadin kowane mako ko wata, wanda aka rubuta a matsayin albashin Mai shi.

say: Saita ajiyar ku ta yadda, idan abokin ciniki ya ɓace, ba ku rasa kome ba. Ba za ku iya sake siyar da masana'anta da aka yanke zuwa girman mutum ɗaya ba. Aiwatar da wannan ga abokai da membobin coci kuma.

say: Don tunawa. Yi amfani da matakai iri ɗaya don kowane oda. Yi alkawari kawai abin da sa'o'in ku suka yarda. Farashin kowane salon kuma kada ku taɓa faɗi ƙasa da farashi. Kuma ajiye littafin kuɗin ku kowace rana.

panel.heading: Ka tuna
items: Guda shida matakai da rikodin ga kowane oda
Kwanakin alkawari daga iyawar ku na mako-mako
Farashi = jimlar farashin da aka raba ta gefen ragi 1
Jimlar farashi shine farashin bene na ku
Rubuta kowace naira a ciki da waje a rana guda

say: Juyin ku. Saita littafin odar ku, farashi mafi kyawun siyar da ku, kuma adana littafin kuɗi na kwanaki 14.
Ci gaba da darussan da ke ƙasa.

panel.heading: Ayyukan aikin ku
items: Saita littafin odar ku kuma adana sharuɗɗan ku
Ku ciyar da mafi kyawun siyar ku ta hanyoyi biyu
Ajiye littafin kuɗi na makonni biyu
Aika tunatarwa ma'auni guda ɗaya
